text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day while walking through the academy, I noticed
an exceptionally glamorous group drawing everyone's attention—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, McQueen.
About that massage oil I promised you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It just arrived from my parents' place, so could you come by my room to pick it up later?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My! Thank you very much.
I was just looking for something good
for a post-training massage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Taking care of your body is very important, after all.
So that you can live every single moment without regret.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It has a lovely fragrance, so I'm sure it will
help you relax. I actually had a perfumer acquaintance of mine
blend it especially for me, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How lovely~! Grooming time can get a bit boring,
but having a nice scent around is so soothing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My hair oil also has a wonderful scent.
Though it was prepared for me by the hair stylist who visits our home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If I don't, my hair goes *poof!* and explodes into a frizzy mess... There really is no rushing this process, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: “Still, your hair is so fluffy, Bright, I really like it.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! I quite envy
silky-smooth hair like Dober's.
Do you use custom-ordered hair oil, after all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well... yeah.
They've been sending me the exact same thing from home all along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's so amazing! I don't really
use fragrances, maybe just deodorant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Ryan-oneesama, have you settled on a brand of antiperspirant?
I would simply love to match with you~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Man, the Mejiro ladies really are built different.
Do you know a perfumer or something?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"No way, haha~. But that kind of makes sense.
Whenever you get close to someone from the Mejiro family,
they smell amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Welcome back, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm ba~ck. Whew, the sale was insanely crowded. I don't smell all sweaty, do I? Am I okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Everything is just fine. Did you manage to find some nice purchases?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, listen to this. The hoodie I wanted
went on sale for half off, but the sizing
was just so awkward~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eee! But Palmer-senpai is definitely still
my fave~! She's so approachable and wonderful, right?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Totally~! And even surrounded by the Mejiros,
she holds her own so proudly—it's so cool!
